cim_eredeti: Krea 3 vs GPT Image 2: Which AI Image Editor to Use in 2026
szoveg_eredeti:
There is no single winner. On Artificial Analysis, Krea 3 Ultra leads GPT Image 2 (high): 1151 Elo against 1136. On Arena’s Multi-Image Edit board, GPT Image 2 leads: GPT-Image-2 (Medium) is #3 at 1453 and Krea 3 Ultra is #4 at 1435. On Design Arena, GPT Image 2 leads as well: 1347 against Krea 3 at 1298. Use Krea 3 when you edit at volume. On krea.ai/krea-3, Krea 3 is 10× faster, 3× cheaper, compared to GPT Image 2 and Nano Banana Pro, and most edits come back in under 8 seconds at native 2K. It keeps the product as it is, down to the label and the logo. For a brand or marketing designer, the real question is which board matches the job, and how many edits you need per campaign.

This guide compares the two on benchmarks, cost, speed, references and limits. Every example is a real Krea 3 edit, shown with the exact prompt that made it. The board-by-board tables are in Krea 3 benchmarks.

One naming note before the details. GPT Image 2 is not the only OpenAI image model any more. On September 8, 2026, OpenAI announced GPT Images 2.5 in the API and ChatGPT, with two new models: GPT Image 2.5 Flare and GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst. OpenAI said ChatGPT Images 2.5 is rolling out to all ChatGPT users, while gpt-image-2 is still listed in OpenAI’s API docs. This post compares Krea 3 with GPT Image 2, and it says where GPT Image 2.5 changes the picture.

Speed figures are the vendors’ own statements; we did not time either model.

On Artificial Analysis, Krea 3 Ultra leads. Ultra is #5 at 1151 Elo, with a rank range of 3–6, statistically tied for #3 with Nano Banana 2.1 and MAI-Image-2.6. GPT Image 2 (high) is at 1136. Krea 3 Fast, the default mode, is #11 at 1125, which is below GPT Image 2 (high) on the point estimate. The Ultra comparison is the one to quote when you are choosing the higher-quality Krea mode.

On Arena’s Multi-Image Edit board, GPT Image 2 leads. GPT-Image-2 (Medium) is #3 at 1453. Krea 3 Ultra is #4 at 1435.

On Design Arena, GPT Image 2 leads. GPT Image 2 is #3 at 1347. Krea 3 is #4 of 51 at 1298 Elo, and Krea is the #2 image-editing lab after OpenAI.

OpenAI’s newer GPT Image 2.5 sits above both on Artificial Analysis. Sunburst (max) is at 1199 Elo and Flare (max) is at 1181, the top two places on the October 20, 2026 read.

The honest summary: Krea 3 Ultra leads on Artificial Analysis (1151 vs GPT Image 2 (high) 1136), while GPT Image 2 leads on Arena and Design Arena. GPT Image 2.5 leads both of them on Artificial Analysis. Do not collapse the three boards into one winner.

Krea 3 is 3× cheaper, compared to GPT Image 2 and Nano Banana Pro. That is the relative claim Krea publishes on krea.ai/krea-3. This post does not print a dollar price for either model. OpenAI bills gpt-image-2 by tokens, and the cost of one image depends on quality and size. Current figures are on the Krea pricing page and on OpenAI’s pricing page.

What you pay for a Krea 3 edit changes with the mode (fast, high, or ultra), the resolution (1K or 2K; Ultra is 2K only), and how many reference images you attach (up to 8).

Retries change the generation count on both models. Every editing model gets things wrong sometimes. If you redo a share of the set, plan for that rate on top of the images you need to keep.

Krea 3 returns most edits in under 8 seconds, end to end, at native 2K. The fastest setup finishes an edit in about 4 to 5 seconds. Krea 3 is not real time yet. On krea.ai/krea-3, Krea 3 is 10× faster, 3× cheaper, compared to GPT Image 2 and Nano Banana Pro. Ultra mode is the exception on speed: it reviews several candidates, is always 2K, can take several minutes, and needs a Max plan or above.

OpenAI’s gpt-image-2 model page lists no typical edit time. Its image generation guide states that “complex prompts may take up to 2 minutes to process” for GPT Image models. We found no published per-edit time for GPT Image 2 to put next to Krea 3’s figure.

Speed matters most when you iterate. If each try comes back in seconds, you can test the next idea in the same sitting.

OpenAI’s launch post says gpt-image-2 “produces precise, usable images with stronger editing, better layouts, improved text rendering”, and it names “improved multilingual text rendering” next to structured layouts such as infographics, charts and posters. It adds more aspect ratios and resolutions up to 2K. OpenAI’s guide says the edits endpoint takes “one or more images” as input, and it also takes a mask, so you can mark the exact area to replace, and the Responses API supports multi-turn edits, where you refine one image over several prompts.

For a designer, the strong case for GPT Image 2 is a text-heavy layout where Arena or Design Arena is the board you trust, and where you accept OpenAI’s token pricing.

Where GPT Image 2 stops. OpenAI’s own guide lists limits for its GPT Image models: latency on complex prompts, text where the model “can still struggle with precise text placement and clarity”, trouble with “visual consistency for recurring characters or brand elements across multiple generations”, and difficulty “placing elements precisely in structured or layout-sensitive compositions”. If you want OpenAI’s best current Artificial Analysis score, look at GPT Image 2.5. Sunburst (max) at 1199 and Flare (max) at 1181 sit above GPT Image 2 (high) at 1136.

Krea 3 is Krea’s image editing model, launched October 15, 2026, and live. It is best at product scene changes, object removal and photo cleanup. It keeps the product as it is, down to the label and the logo, and builds a new scene around it, so a packshot on white becomes a campaign photo. It takes up to 8 reference images per edit, and it can keep the same character across images from a few references.

The prompt pattern starts with what stays, names what matters (the label, the lettering), then describes the new scene like a photographer: light, camera, palette.

For more product workflows, see our guide to AI product photography in 2026.

Keeping brand elements the same across a set is a hard test for any image model. Here Krea 3 took two references, a sweatshirt and a cap, and placed both on a model in a desert. The same two references made two showroom shots with their own prompts. The script “Krea” appliqué stays readable in all three.

Ask Krea 3 to change one thing and it changes one thing. Here it replaced only the sleeves of a ghost-mannequin shirt, using one panel of a sketch sheet, and kept the collar, placket, hem, angle, backdrop and light.

In the API, Krea 3 also has regional edits (regional_edit: true) on fast and high. Only the parts that need to change regenerate, so you can edit the same image again and again without quality loss. ultra does not support regional_edit. For a consistent look across a series, pass one of the reference images as the style example and say which image sets the style. Dedicated style references on Krea 3 are coming soon. The Krea API docs cover the fields.

The Kola bottle below shows the text limit. Krea 3 turned a line keyline and a flat label artwork into a photoreal render. The big “K3 KOLA” logo, the arched slogan and the “12 FL OZ” badge came through. In the small ingredient and research-note columns, several words came out misspelled. Check every word of fine print on packaging before you ship it.

You can also use both: type-heavy hero layouts on the model they trust for text, and product variants and scene changes on Krea 3.

Krea 3 is live on krea.ai, which has 30 million users. Open Krea 3 on krea.ai, upload your packshot, and start the prompt with what must stay. Developers call POST https://api.krea.ai/generate/image/krea/krea-3 and get a job_id back; the developer docs cover uploads, polling and webhooks. Enterprise teams can talk to us about access. For plan details, see pricing.

If your brief starts in ChatGPT, Krea also connects to ChatGPT through its MCP app; our guide on generating with Krea in ChatGPT shows the setup. For a generator comparison, read ChatGPT vs Midjou

lead: A Krea közzétette elemzését a Krea 3 és a GPT Image 2 képszerkesztő modellek teljesítményéről, sebességéről és használati költségeiről.
osszefoglalo:
A Krea közzétette a **Krea 3** és az OpenAI-féle GPT Image 2 modellek részletes összehasonlítását. Az Artificial Analysis mérésein a Krea 3 Ultra 1151 Elo pontszámmal megelőzi a GPT Image 2-t, míg az Arena és a Design Arena tesztjein az OpenAI modellje szerepel jobban.

A Krea mérései szerint a Krea 3 akár **10-szer gyorsabb és 3-szor olcsóbb** a GPT Image 2-nél. A modell a legtöbb szerkesztést 8 másodpercen belül adja vissza natív 2K felbontásban, miközben kiemelten ügyel a képeken látható logók és termékcímkék változatlan megőrzésére.
miert_szamit: A termékfotókkal és kampányanyagokkal dolgozó kreatívok a **Krea 3** segítségével másodpercek alatt cserélhetnek hátteret vagy környezetet a termékazonosítók torzulása nélkül.
